name: MuChoMusic
description: MuChoMusic is a benchmark for evaluating music understanding in multimodal audio-language models. It contains 1,187 multiple-choice questions on 644 music tracks covering various genres, assessing knowledge and reasoning about musical concepts and cultural contexts.
reputation: A recent multimodal music-understanding benchmark that is useful for research but not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Evaluates multimodal models' ability to interpret music-related inputs; highlights challenges in multimodal integration; data and code are open-sourced.
